implementationMessage: Sites v10 is deployed and the server runtime is active. Production GET /api/youtube/streams returns a sanitized configuration_error because YOUTUBE_API_KEY is not configured under the required variable name. Audit found that an API key had accidentally been entered as the environment variable name; that malformed Sites entry was removed immediately.
safetyMessage: STOPPED: the deployed code passed local security and quota-design checks, but production API integration cannot be approved until the exposed/misconfigured Google API key is revoked, a new key is stored in Sites with name YOUTUBE_API_KEY and the key itself as the secret value, v10 is redeployed to apply the new environment revision, and production endpoints are re-audited.
